paper: Streamline Publishing with a Claude Code Skill (dev.to, xbill9/publishing-kit)
primary_source: paper/devto-publishing-kit.md; evidence/*.txt and CLAIMS.md as archived evidence

equations.statement: dev.to proxies the cover at width/height = 2.381:1
a 1376-wide cover keeps 1376/2.381 = 577.9 -> 578 rows
a 1376x768 cover loses 95px off the top and 95px off the bottom
equations.simulation: Pillow ImageOps.fit(1376x768 row-index image -> 1000x420, centering 0.5) with NEAREST resampling; deterministic, no sampling
equations.reason: 768 - 577.92 = 190.08 rows, 95.04 a side under a centre crop. Pillow's fit=cover crop on a row-encoded image agrees within 1 row. The proxy URL says gravity=auto, so the 95/95 split assumes centring; the 190-row total does not depend on it.

equations.statement: the article's own dev.to covers are 1376x578 (ratio 2.381:1), so nothing is cropped
equations.paper_source: evidence/devto-cover-crop.txt last MEASURED line; front matter cover_image
equations.reason: Both cover files on disk measure 1376x578. 1376/578 = 2.3806, wider than 2.38095 by 0.0003, so a fit=cover crop removes 0.08 source columns and 0 rows.

equations.statement: make-cover.py reports which type sizes survive a 320px feed card
equations.reason: CARD_W = 320 in ~/publishing-kit make-cover.py at dec86c0 2026-11-16 (current HEAD, not the 2026-08-31 version). With LEGIBLE_PX = 10, type on a 1376-wide cover must be >= 43.0 source px to survive the card.

equations.statement: 320px is the size a dev.to cover is seen at in the feed
equations.reason: No archived measurement of dev.to's feed card. CLAIMS.md files it as LOG, and the only source is the kit's own constant, which records the author's choice, not dev.to's layout.

equations.statement: 47 of 62 paragraph-level blocks in a published dev.to article carry
equations.simulation: parametric bootstrap, 100000 draws of Binomial(62, 47/62), seed 42
equations.reason:
58 + 4 = 62 = the stated total; 47 <= 88 total
, consistent with blocks that wrap more than once. MCP verify_wilson_ci gives 63.85-84.75%, same as scipy here. One article was measured, so the interval describes that article's blocks, not dev.to in general.

equations.statement: re-hosted Substack cover: mean abs pixel diff 0.0 vs the new cover, 18.71 vs the old one
equations.reason: The re-hosted copy is not archived. If it is 0.0 from the new cover, the triangle inequality forces new-vs-old = 18.71 (within 0.01 for rounding). The local files give 18.775 (RGB) and 18.546 (greyscale), 0.065 off, so the evidence used a method other than these two (it does not name one).

equations.statement: Builder Center hero: mean abs pixel diff 0.56 vs the new cover, 14.66 vs the old one
equations.reason: Triangle inequality: |d(new, old) - 14.66| <= d(hero, new) = 0.56. Local RGB d(new, old) = 14.671, 0.011 from 14.66, inside the bound. The hero itself is not archived.
